To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the structural relationships among the three dimensions of knowledge management are significant.

knowledge management capabilities, knowledge management processes, and knowledge management performance are positively and significantly related to each other, and knowledge management capabilities are the most important antecedent of knowledge management processes and knowledge management performance.

(1) knowledge management capabilities, such as knowledge sharing, knowledge creation, and knowledge storage, positively influence knowledge management processes, such as knowledge transfer, knowledge acquisition, and knowledge integration; (2) knowledge management processes, including knowledge transfer, knowledge creation, knowledge acquisition, knowledge integration, and knowledge application, positively affect knowledge management performance; and (3) knowledge management performance, which includes financial performance and nonfinancial performance, is influenced by knowledge management processes, and knowledge management capabilities.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following issues: 1.
the structural relationship between knowledge management capabilities and processes and their impact on the performance of the organization.
a structural relationship of knowledge management capabilities, knowledge management processes, and knowledge management performance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

knowledge management capabilities and processes are the most important factors for the successful implementation and operation of knowledge management, which leads to improved organizational performance.

the results of this study suggest that knowledge management capability and knowledge management processes have significant effects on knowledge management performance and that knowledge management performance can be improved through the development of knowledge management capabilities and processes.

knowledge management capability and process are the most important factors in achieving knowledge management performance, and knowledge management capability is the most important factor for achieving knowledge management process.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the results of this study suggest the importance of knowledge management capabilities in the implementation of knowledge management and the importance of the balanced scorecards in the performance of the firm.
the capabilities and processes of knowledge management can be considered as an important strategic resource that can lead to the improvement of the performance of a firm.

the results of the empirical study suggest that the BSC approach is an appropriate framework for knowledge management, and that knowledge management capabilities are the key drivers of knowledge management processes and performance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the BSC is an effective strategic tool for the successful implementation and management of knowledge management.
the capabilities, processes and performance of knowledge are all interrelated.
the BSC can be a useful tool for knowledge management.
